title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-4533dd4c38ef03d4a8f522fa
behavioral_concerns: follow up: ValidateQAOperationRequest rejects every caller-owned QA control (model, stage, timeout, parallelism, suite abuse) before PrepareOperation fingerprinting

evidence.summary: validateQAOperationRequest big-if rejects all caller-owned controls and suite/task abuse before fingerprinting

PrepareOperation sequence: normalize -> validateOperationScope -> validateQAOperationRequest -> switch -> canonicalOperationRequest -> fingerprintOperationInputs -> InputFingerprint; returns early on validation error
TestQAOperationPreparationRejectsEveryCallerOwnedControl asserts rejection of stage, model, timeout, parallelism, sources and suite/shard abuse, and acceptance of valid smoke suite

theories.claim: PrepareOperation fingerprinting (canonicalOperationRequest + fingerprintOperationInputs + governedOperationInputs) is sequenced strictly after validateQAOperationRequest, preventing tampered QA controls from being laundered into InputFingerprint/ExpectedFingerprint
theories.basis: operations.go:211-373 defines sequence: clear ExpectedFingerprint -> normalizeOperationRequest -> validateOperationScope -> validateQAOperationRequest -> switch to build Confirmation (including QA shard ownership check 259-265) -> operationPrerequisites -> canonicalOperationRequest -> governedOperationInputs -> fingerprintOperationInputs -> set InputFingerprint/ExpectedFingerprint; validation errors return before 360-373
theories.verification_surface: read-only ordering inspection of operations.go:211-374 and RunOperation 400-410 which re-calls PrepareOperation and checks staleness
theories.confirmation_condition: Any validation failure returns before canonical/fingerprint computation; no fingerprint is cached or returned on error path
theories.refutation_condition: Fingerprint or canonical request is computed before validation, or validation is skipped on RunOperation path allowing ExpectedFingerprint to attest tampered request
theories.inconclusive_condition: Alternative PrepareOperation implementation in another build tag or unlisted path computes fingerprint earlier
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only sequential read of operations.go PrepareOperation and RunOperation; grep for fingerprintOperationInputs and validateQAOperationRequest ordering; no mutation

theories.claim: QA suite abuse (invalid suite value, suite outside start/dry-run, suite+shard mutual exclusion, shard outside start/resume) is rejected by validateQAOperationRequest
theories.basis: operations.go:385-396: if Suite != "" && Suite != "smoke" -> error; if Suite != "" && Kind not in {OperationQAStart,OperationQADryRun} -> error; if Suite != "" && Task != "" -> mutually exclusive error; if Task != "" && Kind not in {OperationQAStart,OperationQAResume} -> error; switch at 377-381 gates only QA kinds
theories.verification_surface: read-only inspection of operations.go:376-398 and web_operations_test.go:169-184, plus operation_runner.go:114 QAStart/Resume handling of Suite
theories.confirmation_condition: All suite-abuse variants (Suite="other", Suite on QAResume/QAStatus/QARecover, Suite+Task together, Task on QAStatus/QADryRun/QARecover) return error from validateQAOperationRequest/PrepareOperation
theories.refutation_condition: Any suite-abuse combination is accepted (nil error) or reaches fingerprint/runner, enabling caller to select arbitrary harness scope or bypass shard ownership
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot determine if web/CLI parsers pre-filter suite before validation or if fingerprinting precedes validation
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only read of operations.go, web_operations_test.go, sprint_commands.go parseSprintQAArgs and web/operation_handlers handling; no execution

theories.claim: validateQAOperationRequest rejects every caller-owned QA control (Model, Stage, Timeout, Parallelism, Study, Level, Test, ForceReview, RestartReview, OverrideRationale, ReviewFocus, Sources, Dimensions) before PrepareOperation fingerprinting
theories.basis: operations.go:211-223 clears ExpectedFingerprint, normalizes, then calls validateOperationScope then validateQAOperationRequest before any CanonicalRequest/InputFingerprint computation (lines 359-374); validateQAOperationRequest:376-398 explicitly checks if req.Study!="" || req.Stage!="" || req.Model!="" || req.Level!="" || req.Test!="" || req.Timeout!="" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale!="" || len(ReviewFocus)>0 || len(Sources)>0 || len(Dimensions)>0 || req.Parallelism!=0 then returns 'QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard'
theories.verification_surface: read-only inspection of assigned context_paths internal/app/operations.go and internal/app/web_operations_test.go; no execution or mutation
theories.confirmation_condition: Every non-empty Model, Stage, Timeout, Parallelism, Level/Test, ForceReview/RestartReview, OverrideRationale, ReviewFocus, Sources, Dimensions, Study causes PrepareOperation and validateQAOperationRequest to return error and no InputFingerprint/CanonicalRequest is produced
theories.refutation_condition: Any listed caller-owned field is accepted by PrepareOperation (nil error) and fingerprinting proceeds, allowing cost/model/timeout/bypass
theories.inconclusive_condition: Source truncated, normalization alters field before check, or alternative entry point bypasses validateQAOperationRequest
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only read/grep of assigned paths operations.go, web_operations_test.go, operation_runner.go; no shell, no writes
